source_name: Happy Monday — Procurement / Purchasing Manager vacancies
why_relevant: Curated UA job board with a dedicated procurement category; smaller volume but often mid/senior roles at banks and financial companies, with richer job descriptions that reveal category structure.

source_name: YouControl / Opendatabot — association & member legal-entity resolver
why_relevant: Resolves association and member names to EDRPOU codes, founders and beneficiaries — the join key that turns an association member list into Prozorro buyer/supplier identifiers. Example shown: EMA (EDRPOU 30401000), UAFIC (42031209), NABU (37924657), UCBS (21573585).

source_name: Diia Business — довідник підприємця: асоціація членів платіжних систем ЄМА
why_relevant: State-run business handbook entry describing EMA and its role; a government-side pointer that helps validate association identity and can list other sectoral associations.

source_name: Ukraine Fintech Week (UAFIC) — programme, donors and partner institutions
why_relevant: Post-event write-ups name the donor/IFI backers (IFC, World Bank Group, SECO) and the themes they fund. Donor-funded programmes very often precede public tenders for banking/payments modernisation — a strong pre-tender signal.

source_name: Верховна Рада — Законодавство України (zakon.rada.gov.ua): Постанова КМУ №1178 «Особливості здійснення публічних закупівель ... на період дії воєнного стану»
why_relevant: Authoritative consolidated text of the wartime procurement regime: defines simplified/direct-contract grounds, thresholds, exemptions and shortened publication duties. All UA wartime buying of payment/cash equipment is legally framed by this act and its amendments; tracking its revision history tells you when new exemption windows open.

source_name: Кабінет Міністрів України — офіційний портал НПА (kmu.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Primary publisher of the resolutions that create special/closed procurement regimes and of resolutions authorising specific large purchases outside Prozorro. New exemption regimes appear here first, often before commentary.

source_name: Мінекономіки — розділ законодавчих актів у сфері публічних закупівель (me.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Ministry of Economy is the authorised body for public procurement: publishes the acts, official clarifications (роз'яснення) and interpretation of which purchases may bypass Prozorro. Its clarifications drive buyer behaviour in the exempt regime.

source_name: Prozorro Інфобокс — «Звітування для потреб оборони» / «Проводимо закупівлі в умовах воєнного стану»
why_relevant: Operator's own knowledge base explaining exactly HOW exempt/defence purchases are reported back into the system (звіт про договір, 'закупівля без використання електронної системи', deferred publication 90 days after martial law). This is the key to knowing where post-hoc disclosure of hidden spend eventually surfaces and under which record type.

source_name: OpenProcurement API documentation (Prozorro API)
why_relevant: Documents the 'reporting' procedure type used for exempt/without-e-system contracts and the negotiation/limited procedures — the technical handle for systematically extracting the special-regime slice rather than only open tenders.

source_name: Transparency International Ukraine — Public Procurement Oversight (EN)
why_relevant: English-language framing of the same wartime exemption story, useful for cross-checking Ukrainian sources and for citable summaries of how much procurement moved outside competitive procedures.

source_name: Агенція оборонних закупівель (ДОТ) / Міністерство оборони України — пояснення щодо закупівель та розкриття інформації
why_relevant: The central defence buyer whose non-lethal purchases (logistics, IT, field banking/cash handling for personnel payments) fall under closed procedures. MoD explanation pages state which categories are withheld — defining the boundary of what can ever be observed.

source_name: АТ «Укрпошта» — розділ закупівель / інформація про закупівлі
why_relevant: Reconstruction-era buyer of branch payment acceptance, POS terminals, cash distribution and card top-up services, plus core IT (e.g. a ~UAH 197m ERP tender). Buys under postal/IT classifications, invisible to banking-keyword searches. EDRPOU 21560045.

source_name: АТ «Укрзалізниця» — публічні закупівлі та Платформа постачальників
why_relevant: Large infrastructure buyer of ticketing, fare-collection and cash-desk (каси) equipment classified as transport/IT, not banking. Runs both Prozorro procedures and a separate supplier platform, which can carry pre-qualification and non-Prozorro-visible sourcing.

source_name: НЕК «Укренерго» — закупівлі (профіль замовника, EDRPOU 00100227)
why_relevant: Critical-infrastructure buyer under reconstruction financing; buys billing, metering and payment-collection IT. Some energy-sector purchases fall under special critical-infrastructure exemptions, making the buyer-profile view a practical way to see what still surfaces.

source_name: Київська ОВА — розділ «Публічні закупівлі» / відкриті дані (модель для всіх ОВА)
why_relevant: Oblast military administrations publish procurement notices on their own sites, including announcements for direct contracts that carry little Prozorro visibility. The pattern (a 'публічні закупівлі' or 'відкриті дані' section per ОВА site) is replicable across all 24 oblasts.

source_name: DREAM — Державна екосистема управління відновленням (+ bi.dream.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Registry of reconstruction projects with an integrated procurement pipeline ('Бізнес-можливості') that shows planned tenders before they hit Prozorro. Best forward-looking indicator of reconstruction-programme demand, including equipment for administrative and service buildings.

source_name: Державна аудиторська служба України (ДАСУ) — моніторинг закупівель, плани діяльності
why_relevant: Monitoring decisions and audit findings frequently describe the substance of contracts concluded under exemptions — i.e. they reveal purchases that were otherwise minimally published. The monitoring register is itself an index of contested wartime contracts.

source_name: Рахункова палата України — звіти аудитів (rp.gov.ua)
why_relevant: Supreme audit institution reports are one of the very few sources that quantify spend inside closed/defence and simplified regimes, including rear-area (тилові) procurement. Reports include figures and supplier structure not published elsewhere.

source_name: Спеціалізовані закупівельні медіа: RADNUK, ProZakupivli (blog.zakupivli.pro), ДЗ-Платформа, Юридична Газета
why_relevant: Practitioner press that explains, in operational terms, which grounds buyers actually use for direct contracts and how exemption thresholds shift after each amendment. Faster and more concrete than the legal text; good early-warning layer.

source_name: LIGA:ZAKON IPS — консолідовані редакції актів про закупівлі
why_relevant: Commercial legal database with dated consolidated editions, which makes it possible to reconstruct exactly which exemption rules applied on a given date — necessary when interpreting a historical contract concluded without open bidding.

source_name: UNIAN / незалежна розслідувальна преса про неконкурентні тендери ОВА
why_relevant: Investigative reporting quantifies the share of oblast-administration purchases made non-competitively (reported as 92.3% in one oblast). Such pieces reveal supplier networks and contract substance that the formal record understates.

source_name: Prozorro central portal — buyer filter by EDRPOU (universal buyer-profile entry point)
source_subtype: official e-procurement portal / buyer profile view
why_relevant: Prozorro is the legally mandated publication venue for all state-owned bank procurement. The ?buyer=<EDRPOU> query renders a per-buyer feed, so each state bank in this cell can be pinned to a stable buyer URL: Oschadbank 00032129, Ukreximbank 00032112, PrivatBank 14360570, Ukrgasbank 23697280, Sense Bank 23494714, Ukrposhta 21560045, DP Diia 43395033, NBU 00032106.

source_name: Prozorro / OpenProcurement public API (openprocurement.api) + API docs
why_relevant: Machine-readable access to the same central database that backs every buyer page in this cell — tenders, lots, items, CPV, bids, awards, contracts. The only sane way to build a longitudinal buyer profile for the state banks instead of scraping aggregator HTML.

source_name: PrivatBank official tender platform — tender.privatbank.ua
why_relevant: PrivatBank's own buyer-side platform ('Всі закупівлі ПриватБанку'). It is the successor to the retired zakupivli24.pb.ua and carries the bank's own commercial procurement, including items that never surface as classic Prozorro open tenders. Highest-volume state bank buyer in the country.
